content.text:
All three renders are done and verified.

**Files in the folder:**
- `square.png` — 1080×1080 (master)
- `landscape.png` — 1920×1080
- `story.png` — 1080×1920
- `card.html` — source (one layout file, `?f=square|landscape|story`)

**Design:** `#0F1226` base with soft violet radial glows, Inter loaded via `@font-face`, white text and `#7C5CFF` accent on the logo rule, "KEYNOTE" kicker, portrait ring and the pill CTA.

**Per-format layout rather than scaling:**
- *Square:* logo + event name header, portrait beside the name/role, 70px title over 3 lines, date/venue and "Get tickets" split across the baseline.
- *Landscape:* two columns — 76px title on the left, portrait with name/role stacked on the right — with the header and footer spanning full width so the name fits on a single line.
- *Story:* fully centered column, 440px portrait, 80px title over 4 lines, stacked meta + button footer.

**Checks run:** font load confirmed (`document.fonts.check`), zero content overflow on `.inner` in every size, measured bounding boxes to confirm no overlaps between blocks, portrait measured square (so the 50% radius stays a true circle), title wrapping onto 3–4 lines with nothing clipped, and non-breaking hyphens in "Okonkwo‑Lindqvist" and "on‑call" so they never break across lines. Output dimensions verified as exactly 1080×1080, 1920×1080 and 1080×1920.
